morbi.headline: Mixed week as falling freight and cheaper fuel balance declining tile export projections.
what_changed: Tile export market projections dropped to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Morbi ceramic units reduced PNG consumption following improved propane supply availability.
Ocean container freight rates for Morbi ceramics dropped by up to 50 percent.
Somany Ceramics announced a 5 MSM capacity hike via debottlenecking.
stress_signals: Overall tile exports are projected to decline to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore [202e1481c238]
improvement_signals: Ocean container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent for export shipments [d6c30857de2c]
Improved propane supply allowed Morbi ceramic units to cut higher-cost PNG consumption [81469af468f3]
what_to_watch: Destination-wise export volumes to assess the actual impact of the Rs 12,000-13,000 crore projection.
Propane vs PNG price differentials and fuel substitution levels across MSME ceramic kilns.
Details on Somany Ceramics' 5 MSM debottlenecking plan, including capex, funding mix, and location impact [0f642d309dd8].

surat.headline: Surat diamonds see demand revival despite rough shortages; textiles face muted festive demand and payment stress.
what_changed: Diamond processing units are shortening Diwali holidays and reopening early to meet recovering demand after a four-year slump.
Textile position printing charges increased by 15% with a strict 45-day payment window post-Diwali.
Surat Textile Policy approved 627 new units, attracting Rs 1,521 crore in investment.
stress_signals: Divergence in key sectors as MMF textile festive demand remains muted while diamond trade recovers [id d6a824e747af].
Diamond units faced pre-Diwali closures due to acute shortages of rough diamonds despite demand revival [id b65b93c4b724].
Persistent trade fraud in the textile market prompting SGCCI to request strict GUJCTOC implementation against defaulting gangs [id 421d4bf835f5].
Reported suicide of a Surat diamond merchant highlighting underlying individual liquidity and debt distress [id 9edf027a29a8].
improvement_signals: Diamond cutting and polishing units halved Diwali breaks and scheduled early reopenings on improving order inflows [id 5fc0b7b85616, id bd78e4a130ff].
Overall recovery in diamond jewellery demand following a four-year slump [id bae3b8d48691].
MANTRA selected for an IIT Madras national sustainability project and expanded into MedTech textile testing [id 8cfd965ad293, id 5e7cd22236e9].
what_to_watch: Impact of the 15% printing cost hike and 45-day payment mandates on working capital cycles of weaving and embroidery MSMEs.
Rough diamond supply chain availability post-Diwali to sustain the early reopening of polishing units.
Compliance friction from the Textile Ministry's fabric capacity database tracking drive and local fire safety inspections.
